---
title: "scRNA-seq PBS vs AEC: mast cells, T cells, B cells, dendritic cells and neutrophils"
author: "Yuxi"
date: "2022-11-24"
output: html_document
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: inline
---

Single cell RNA-seq of one PBS-treated and one AEC-treated mouse. Ambient RNA was removed with CellBender.
This script was written for Seurat v4. To run it with Seurat v5, keep `options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")` in the setup chunk.

Subclustering, DEGs and enrichment for each of the other immune cell types.
Starts from the objects in `data/cell/` saved by `01_QC_integration_annotation.Rmd`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r load all the packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(Seurat)
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")

library(cowplot)
library(clustree)
library(niceRplots)
library(scCustomize)
library(harmony)
library(geomtextpath)
library(webr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

#For preprocessing
library(DoubletFinder)

#For Cell interaction
library(CellChat)
library(liana)

#For enrichment Analysis
library(correlationAnalyzeR)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(xlsx)
library(gprofiler2)
library(plotly)
library(DOSE)

#For transcriptional factor network
library(loomR)

#For Trajectory imputation
library(slingshot)
library(tradeSeq)
library(fields)
library(rafalib)

for (d in c("data/cell", "results/cell/Myeloid", "results/cell/Myeloid/Trajectory", "results/cell/Mast", "results/cell/Tcell", "results/cell/Bcell", "results/cell/DC", "results/cell/Neutrophil", "results/cell/Cellchat", "results/cell/LIANA", "results/cell/SCENIC")) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
```


```{r Mast Cells}
DATA_Immune <- readRDS("data/cell/Cell_Immune.rds")
DATA_Immune <- SetIdent(DATA_Immune, value = "Celltypes")

DATA_Mast <- subset(DATA_Immune, idents = c("Mast Cell"))

DefaultAssay(DATA_Mast) <- "CCA"
DATA_Mast <- ScaleData(DATA_Mast, features = rownames(DATA_Mast))
DATA_Mast <- RunPCA(DATA_Mast, npcs = 30)
DATA_Mast <- RunUMAP(DATA_Mast, dims = 1:30)

DimPlot(DATA_Mast, group.by = "Condition")

# Redo the clustering ----
DATA_Mast <- FindNeighbors(DATA_Mast, dims = 1:30, k.param = 15)

for (res in c(0.1, 0.15,0.16,0.17,0.18,0.2,0.25,0.3,0.35,0.4,0.45, 0.5,0.55,0.6,0.65,0.75, 1,1.25, 1.5,1.75, 2,2.25, 2.5,3)) {
  print(paste0("current res", res))
    DATA_Mast <- FindClusters(DATA_Mast, graph.name = "CCA_snn", resolution = res, algorithm = 1)
}

clustree(DATA_Mast@meta.data, prefix = "CCA_snn_res.")
DATA_Mast$seurat_subclusters <- DATA_Mast$CCA_snn_res.0.1

DefaultAssay(DATA_Mast)<- "RNA"

DimPlot(DATA_Mast, group.by = "CCA_snn_res.0.1", label = T)
plot_dots(DATA_Mast, genes = c("Il4","Il1rl1","Cpa3","Mcpt8","Cd200r3","Cx3cr1","Cxcr4","Hif1a"),clustering = "Condition")
VlnPlot(DATA_Mast,group.by = "Condition",features = c("Il4","Il1rl1","Cpa3","Mcpt8","Cd200r3","Cx3cr1","Cxcr4","Hif1a"))
plot_grid(FeaturePlot(DATA_Mast, c("Il4","Il1rl1","Cpa3","Mcpt8", "H2-K1","H2-D1","Mcpt1","Top2a","Mki67")),DimPlot(DATA_Mast,group.by = "CCA_snn_res.0.1"))
VlnPlot(DATA_Immune,c("Il4","Il1rl1","Cpa3","Mcpt8","Cd200","Cd200r3","Il33"),group.by = "Celltypes")

# DEGs for condition----
DATA_Mast <- SetIdent(DATA_Mast, value = "Condition")
detable_all <- FindAllMarkers(DATA_Mast, log2FC.threshold = 0.2,
    min.pct = 0.1, min.diff.pct = 0.2, only.pos = TRUE, max.cells.per.ident = Inf,
    assay = "RNA")

detable_all <- detable_all[ detable_all$p_val < 0.05,  ]
detable_all$pct.diff <- detable_all$pct.1 - detable_all$pct.2
detable_all$log.pct.diff <- log2(detable_all$pct.1 / (detable_all$pct.2+0.01) )

detable_all %>% group_by(cluster)  %>% top_n(-10, p_val) %>% top_n(5, log.pct.diff) -> top5_all
detable_all %>% group_by(cluster)  %>% top_n(-50, p_val) %>% top_n(20, log.pct.diff) -> top20_all
write.csv(top20_all, file = "results/cell/Mast/Mast_ConditionMarkers_top20.csv")
write.csv(detable_all, file = "results/cell/Mast/Mast_ConditionMarkers_All.csv")
write.csv(top5_all, file = "results/cell/Mast/Mast_ConditionMarkers_top5.csv")

plot_dots(DATA_Mast, genes = c( as.character(unique(top20_all$gene))),assay = "RNA",clustering = "Condition", pal = c("#cfc8d7","#a577f2", "#0434ff"))

#GSEA Analysis on each condition----
TERM2GENE <- getTERM2GENE(GSEA_Type = "GO:BP", Species = "mmusculus")
KEGG <- getTERM2GENE(GSEA_Type = "KEGG", Species = "mmusculus")

for (i in c("PBS","AEC")) {
print(paste0("Current Condition is ", i))
geneList <- detable_all[detable_all$cluster == i,]$avg_log2FC
names(geneList)=detable_all[detable_all$cluster == i,]$gene
geneList=sort(geneList,decreasing = T)

GOBP <-GSEA(geneList, TERM2GENE =TERM2GENE,
            pvalueCutoff = 1, scoreType = "pos")
write.xlsx(as.data.frame(GOBP@result), file = "results/cell/Mast/Mast_GSEA.xlsx", sheetName = paste0("GSEA_GO_Condition",i), append = TRUE)

GOBP <-GSEA(geneList, TERM2GENE =KEGG,
            pvalueCutoff = 1, scoreType = "pos")
write.xlsx(as.data.frame(GOBP@result), file = "results/cell/Mast/Mast_GSEA.xlsx", sheetName = paste0("GSEA_KEGG_Condition",i), append = TRUE)
}

# Geneoncology ----
for (i in c("PBS","AEC")) {
print(paste0("Current Condition is ", i))
genelist=detable_all[detable_all$cluster == i,]$gene
go = gost(genelist, organism = 'mmusculus')

write.xlsx(as.data.frame(go$result[, c("term_name","p_value", "intersection_size", "term_size","term_id", "source")]), file = "results/cell/Mast/Mast_GSEA.xlsx", sheetName = paste0("GO_Condition ",i), append = TRUE)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(as_widget(gostplot(go,interactive = T)%>% layout(title = paste0("Condition ", i))), paste0("results/cell/Mast/Mast_Condition ",i," GO.html"))
}

```

```{r B Cell}
DATA_Immune <- readRDS("data/cell/Cell_Immune.rds")

DefaultAssay(DATA_B) <- "CCA"

DATA_B <- RunUMAP(DATA_B, dims = 1:30)

DimPlot(DATA_B)
FeaturePlot(DATA_B, features = c("Pax5","Cd19", "Cxcr4", "Tnfrsf17"))

# Redo the clustering ----
DATA_B <- FindNeighbors(DATA_B, dims = 1:30, k.param = 10)

for (res in c(0.1, 0.15,0.16,0.17,0.18,0.2,0.25,0.3,0.35,0.4,0.45, 0.5,0.55,0.6,0.65,0.75, 1,1.25, 1.5,1.75, 2,2.25, 2.5,3)) {

}

clustree(DATA_B@meta.data, prefix = "CCA_snn_res.")

# Generate Cluster Specific GeneList ----
DefaultAssay(DATA_B) <-  "RNA"
plot_dots(DATA_B, genes = c("Fas","Cd69","Cd80","Cd86","Cd40","Tnfrsf13c","Tnfrsf13b","H2-Aa", "H2-Ab1", "H2-D1", "H2-DMa", "H2-DMb1", "H2-DMb2", "H2-Ea-ps", "H2-Eb1", "H2-K1", "H2-M3", "H2-Ob", "H2-Q1", "H2-Q10", "H2-Q2", "H2-T23","Cd74","Cd27","Ptprc","Cd38","Slc3a2","Cxcr4","Ly6k","Atxn1","Sdc1","Irf4","Igsf1","Ighg2b","Ighm","Ighg1","Ighd","Iglc2","Iglc3","Iglc1","Iglv2","Ighe","Jchain","Vpreb1","Pax5","Cd19","Cd1d","Cd24a","Cd22"),clustering = "CCA_snn_res.0.1")
plot_dots(DATA_B, genes = c("Ighd","Ighm","Cd69","Cd79a","Cd38","H2-D1", "H2-K1","H2-Aa", "H2-Ab1", "H2-DMa", "H2-DMb1", "H2-DMb2", "H2-Ea-ps", "H2-Eb1",  "H2-M3", "H2-Ob", "H2-Q1", "H2-Q10", "H2-Q2", "H2-T23","Cd74","Ms4a1"),clustering = "Condition", pal = c("#cfc8d7","#a577f2", "#0434ff"))

DATA_B <- SetIdent(DATA_B, value = "CCA_snn_res.0.1")
detable_all <- FindAllMarkers(DATA_B, log2FC.threshold = 0.2,
    min.pct = 0.1, min.diff.pct = 0.2, only.pos = TRUE, max.cells.per.ident = Inf,
    assay = "RNA")

detable_all <- detable_all[ detable_all$p_val < 0.05,  ]
detable_all$pct.diff <- detable_all$pct.1 - detable_all$pct.2
detable_all$log.pct.diff <- log2(detable_all$pct.1 / (detable_all$pct.2+0.01) )

detable_all %>% group_by(cluster)  %>% top_n(-10, p_val) %>% top_n(5, log.pct.diff) -> top5_all
detable_all %>% group_by(cluster)  %>% top_n(-50, p_val) %>% top_n(20, log.pct.diff) -> top20_all
write.csv(top20_all, file = "results/cell/Bcell/Bcell_ClusterMarkers_top20.csv")
write.csv(detable_all, file = "results/cell/Bcell/Bcell_ClusterMarkers_All.csv")
write.csv(top5_all, file = "results/cell/Bcell/Bcell_ClusterMarkers_top5.csv")
plot_dots(DATA_B, genes = c( as.character(unique(top20_all$gene)), "Top2a", "Mki67"),main = "B cell",assay = "RNA",clustering = "CCA_snn_res.0.1", pal = c("#cfc8d7","#a577f2", "#0434ff"))

# Proportions----
summarized.df <- DATA_B@meta.data %>%
  group_by(Condition, CCA_snn_res.0.1) %>%
  summarize(nCells = n()) %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  mutate(prop = nCells/sum(nCells))
ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = summarized.df, aes(Condition, prop, fill = CCA_snn_res.0.1), stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  coord_flip()

#GSEA Analysis on each clusters----
TERM2GENE <- getTERM2GENE(GSEA_Type = "GO:BP", Species = "mmusculus")
KEGG <- getTERM2GENE(GSEA_Type = "KEGG", Species = "mmusculus")

for (i in c("0","1")) {
print(paste0("Current Cluster is ", i))
geneList <- detable_all[detable_all$cluster == i,]$avg_log2FC
names(geneList)=detable_all[detable_all$cluster == i,]$gene
geneList=sort(geneList,decreasing = T)

GOBP <-GSEA(geneList, TERM2GENE =TERM2GENE,
            pvalueCutoff = 1, scoreType = "pos")
write.xlsx(as.data.frame(GOBP@result), file = "results/cell/Bcell/Bcell_GSEA.xlsx", sheetName = paste0("GSEA_GO_Cluster",i), append = TRUE)

            pvalueCutoff = 1, scoreType = "pos")
write.xlsx(as.data.frame(GOBP@result), file = "results/cell/Bcell/Bcell_GSEA.xlsx", sheetName = paste0("GSEA_KEGG_Cluster",i), append = TRUE)
}

#DotPlot for GSEA----
geneList <- detable_all[detable_all$cluster == 0,]$avg_log2FC
names(geneList)=detable_all[detable_all$cluster == 0,]$gene
geneList=sort(geneList,decreasing = T)

GOBP <-GSEA(geneList, TERM2GENE =TERM2GENE,
            pvalueCutoff = 0.1, scoreType= "pos")
dotplot(GOBP, showCategory=c("GOBP_RESPONSE_TO_CYTOKINE", "GOBP_REGULATION_OF_CELL_DEATH", "GOBP_RESPONSE_TO_LIPID", "GOBP_NEGATIVE_REGULATION_OF_CELL_DEATH", "GOBP_NEGATIVE_REGULATION_OF_LIPID_LOCALIZATION", "GOBP_CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_GLUCOSE_STARVATION", "GOBP_CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_LIPID")
)

# Geneoncology ----
for (i in c("0","1")) {
print(paste0("Current Cluster is ", i))
genelist=detable_all[detable_all$cluster == i,]$gene
go = gost(genelist, organism = 'mmusculus')

write.xlsx(as.data.frame(go$result[, c("term_name","p_value", "intersection_size", "term_size","term_id", "source")]), file = "results/cell/Bcell/Bcell_GSEA.xlsx", sheetName = paste0("GO_Cluster ",i), append = TRUE)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(as_widget(gostplot(go,interactive = T)%>% layout(title = paste0("Cluster ", i))), paste0("results/cell/Bcell/Bcell_Cluster ",i," GO.html"))
}
```

```{r Neutrophil}
detable_all$log.pct.diff <- log2(detable_all$pct.1 / (detable_all$pct.2+0.01) )

detable_all %>% group_by(cluster)  %>% top_n(-10, p_val) %>% top_n(5, log.pct.diff) -> top5_all
detable_all %>% group_by(cluster)  %>% top_n(-50, p_val) %>% top_n(20, log.pct.diff) -> top20_all
write.csv(top20_all, file = "results/cell/Neutrophil/Neutrophil_ConditionMarkers_top20.csv")
write.csv(detable_all, file = "results/cell/Neutrophil/Neutrophil_ConditionMarkers_All.csv")
write.csv(top5_all, file = "results/cell/Neutrophil/Neutrophil_ConditionMarkers_top5.csv")
plot_dots(DATA_Neutrophil, genes = c( as.character(unique(top20_all$gene))),main = "Neutrophil ",assay = "RNA",clustering = "Condition", pal = c("#cfc8d7","#a577f2", "#0434ff"))

#GSEA Analysis on each condition----
TERM2GENE <- getTERM2GENE(GSEA_Type = "GO:BP", Species = "mmusculus")
KEGG <- getTERM2GENE(GSEA_Type = "KEGG", Species = "mmusculus")

for (i in c("PBS","AEC")) {
print(paste0("Current Condition is ", i))
geneList <- detable_all[detable_all$cluster == i,]$avg_log2FC
names(geneList)=detable_all[detable_all$cluster == i,]$gene
geneList=sort(geneList,decreasing = T)

GOBP <-GSEA(geneList, TERM2GENE =TERM2GENE,
            pvalueCutoff = 1, scoreType = "pos")
write.xlsx(as.data.frame(GOBP@result), file = "results/cell/Neutrophil/Neutrophil_GSEA.xlsx", sheetName = paste0("GSEA_GO_Condition",i), append = TRUE)

GOBP <-GSEA(geneList, TERM2GENE =KEGG,
            pvalueCutoff = 1, scoreType = "pos")
write.xlsx(as.data.frame(GOBP@result), file = "results/cell/Neutrophil/Neutrophil_GSEA.xlsx", sheetName = paste0("GSEA_KEGG_Condition",i), append = TRUE)
}

# Geneoncology ----
for (i in c("PBS","AEC")) {
print(paste0("Current Condition is ", i))
genelist=detable_all[detable_all$cluster == i,]$gene
go = gost(genelist, organism = 'mmusculus')

write.xlsx(as.data.frame(go$result[, c("term_name","p_value", "intersection_size", "term_size","term_id", "source")]), file = "results/cell/Neutrophil/Neutrophil_GSEA.xlsx", sheetName = paste0("GO_Condition ",i), append = TRUE)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(as_widget(gostplot(go,interactive = T)%>% layout(title = paste0("Condition ", i))), paste0("results/cell/Neutrophil/Neutrophil_Condition ",i," GO.html"))
}
```
